description: Section-level per-step visibility: the SAME Permission shape as a field, but Column points at a Section column instead of a Field column — one Permission hides/shows every field inside it at once. Far cheaper than field-level (8x steps vs field-count x steps).
notes: This lever was long believed not to exist (0-of-132 in one oracle sample) until the builder's own "hide section at this step" action was captured writing exactly this shape — absence in one sample is not absence in the API.

Field-level and section-level Permission nodes coexist untouched by each other on a live flow (1159 field-level + 5 section-level observed together); precedence when both disagree (section Hidden vs a field inside it Editable) is UNVERIFIED — do not rely on it.
StartEvent is workflow position 0 — the section carrying the initial submission form's fields must list Start as an owner, or the form renders empty on creation.
